entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed. I've been a loyal customer for years, and it's just not working at all.

Oh no, I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I'm on the right track, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's definitely a technical fault. I think the band is broken. It just won't sync with my phone, no matter what I do. The screen flashes, but that's it. It feels completely defective.

I see. A device that won't sync is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. I can only imagine how frustrating that must be. Let me pull up your account and see what we can do. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I really saved up for this, you know? I was so excited, and I really needed this money for other things if it wasn't going to work out. I just feel so let down.
I completely understand, and thank you for that order number. Please give me just one moment to review your purchase details and our policy...
Okay, I have your order pulled up. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 22 days ago. Let me just confirm our internal guidelines... yes, okay. I have good news for you.
According to our policy here, you are well within the 90-day return window. Since the item is defective, we can absolutely process a full return for you. No problem at all.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with a broken device. Thank you.

Of course. It's the least we can do. I'm generating a prepaid return shipping label for you right now, and it should be in your email inbox within the next five minutes. Just pack the item back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund. Does that sound okay?
That sounds perfect. You've been a great help, Sarah. Thank you so much for making this easy.
You're very welcome. We appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit, and I'm sorry again for the trouble with the band. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
